notes.title: Playtest #3!
notes.content:
[h1]🎮 [b]Welcome to Playtest #3![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We've been working hard to improve [i]Kingdom Loop[/i], and we can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524139/0ab563088c44586fd427e97349d37e6256a42b7f.png"][/img][/p][p]This update brings a ton of new features:[/p][p]🃏 [b]Cards are now even more valuable[/b] —
Winning battles grants you random cards — the stronger the enemy, the better the reward.[/p][p]⚔️ [b]New Units[/b] —
A variety of new combat units have been added to the Human faction.[/p][p]🏡 [b]Tile Upgrades Through Combos![/b] —
Upgraded tiles can now evolve for free when placed in the right combinations![/p][p]🕹 [b]Turn-Based Combat System[/b] —
Battles are now fully turn-based, with deeper tactical mechanics.[/p][p]📖 [b]Story and Dialogue Updates[/b][/p][p]🏆 [b]Special Grail Tile[/b] —
Can be found at the center of the map.[/p][p]💬 [b]Share your feedback![/b]
Your impressions help us make the game even better. And remember — this is just the beginning. There’s much more to come![/p]

tags.feature:
🃏 [b]Cards are now even more valuable[/b] —
Winning battles grants you random cards — the stronger the enemy, the better the reward.

⚔️ [b]New Units[/b] —
A variety of new combat units have been added to the Human faction.

🏡 [b]Tile Upgrades Through Combos![/b] —
Upgraded tiles can now evolve for free when placed in the right combinations!

🕹 [b]Turn-Based Combat System[/b] —
Battles are now fully turn-based, with deeper tactical mechanics.

🏆 [b]Special Grail Tile[/b] —
Can be found at the center of the map.
